integrations.hint: Webhooks send an event to your CMDB, ITSM or any other system when something happens. Each request is signed so the receiver can check it came from here.
integrations.name: Name
integrations.urlHelp: Must be http or https. Addresses that point at the server itself or at cloud metadata are refused.
integrations.rotateConfirm: Rotate the secret of "{name}"? The old secret keeps signing for 24 hours (header X-Sampark-Signature-Previous) so you can switch the receiver over.
integrations.deleteConfirm: Delete the webhook "{name}" and its delivery log?
integrations.secretHint: Copy the secret now. It is shown only once; if you lose it, rotate it.
integrations.verify: Each request is a POST with a JSON body and the headers X-Sampark-Event, X-Sampark-Delivery, X-Sampark-Timestamp and X-Sampark-Signature. The signature is sha256= followed by the HMAC-SHA256 of "timestamp.body" (the timestamp, a dot, then the raw body) with your secret. Reject requests with an old timestamp. A non-2xx answer is retried up to 5 times (after 1 minute, 5 minutes, 30 minutes and 2 hours).
integrations.apiKeysNote: To let another system read or update this data, create an API key (read or write scope) and call the /external/v1 endpoints: lifecycle/expiring, maintenance/due, config/status, and PATCH assets/(id)/lifecycle.
